items.description_en:
`SearchTlog` returns a detailed list of logs. Each item in `items[]` represents a log entry. Time fields are uniformly in Unix millisecond timestamps.

app String Application identifier, typically in the format `<appKey>@<os>`
server_time Long The time when the server received or wrote the log, in Unix millisecond timestamp
client_time Long The time when the client generated the log, in Unix millisecond timestamp
sub_type_1 String Primary log type, typically representing the log level, such as E, W, or I
sub_type_2 String Secondary log type, typically representing the module name, log category, or a custom business module
type String Log type field, which may be empty. The specific meaning is determined by the client SDK or business write logic
message String Log body content
udid String Device identifier, corresponding to the deviceId in the device query chain
collectionId String Log collection record ID, typically corresponding to a proactive report or log retrieval collection result
taskId String Log collection task ID, which can be used to associate with a log retrieval task or a proactive report task
properties Object Log extended properties object, containing additional fields written by the client
properties.level String Log level
properties.module String Log module name or business module identifier
properties.tag String Log tag, which may be empty
properties.type String Extended type field, which may be empty
properties.clientTime String Client-formatted time string, used for display or troubleshooting
properties.seq Long Client log sequence number, used to determine the order in which logs were generated
md5 String Serialized string of the log digest or full log content. In the current response, it may be a log JSON string. Business logic should not strongly depend on its internal structure
items.description_zh:
`SearchTlog` 返回日志明细列表，`items[]` 中每一项表示一条日志记录。时间字段统一为 Unix 毫秒时间戳。

app String 应用标识，通常格式为 `<appKey>@<os>`
server_time Long 服务端接收或写入日志的时间，Unix 毫秒时间戳
client_time Long 客户端产生日志的时间，Unix 毫秒时间戳
sub_type_1 String 一级日志类型，通常表示日志级别，例如 E、W、I
sub_type_2 String 二级日志类型，通常表示模块名、日志分类或业务自定义模块
type String 日志类型字段，可能为空，具体含义由端上 SDK 或业务写入逻辑决定
message String 日志正文内容
udid String 设备标识，对应设备查询链路中的 deviceId
collectionId String 日志采集记录 ID，通常对应一次主动上报或回捞采集结果
taskId String 日志采集任务 ID，可用于关联回捞任务或主动上报任务
properties Object 日志扩展属性对象，包含端上写入的附加字段
properties.level String 日志级别
properties.module String 日志模块名或业务模块标识
properties.tag String 日志标签，可能为空
properties.type String 扩展类型字段，可能为空
properties.clientTime String 客户端格式化时间字符串，用于展示或辅助排查
properties.seq Long 客户端日志序号，用于判断日志产生顺序
md5 String 日志摘要或完整日志内容的序列化字符串，当前返回中可能是日志 JSON 字符串，不建议业务强依赖其内部结构
